brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: pieces at 0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,1,0 (full hex bases) form the base structure, each with top covers
3 removable bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 – full-depth with 2 compartments for small electronics parts, drop-in removable type
notch:0#1,1#notch2 hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf provides a pull-out drawer in the gap between bases 1,0,0 and 0,1,0 at cell 1,1
handle:0,0,0;top mounted on cover:0,0,0;full;top with insert anchors (visible in build)

finish.summary: Portable organizer built as compact L-shaped cluster of 3 full hex bases, each fitted with divided removable bins for small parts, with a notch drawer bridging the cluster and a top-mounted carry handle on the central base. Mesh check is clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
